en-US.title: Adaptive Tutor
en-US.subtitle: Local AI tutor & quiz master
en-US.description:
Adaptive Tutor is a private AI study buddy that turns any subject into a personal tutoring session.

LEARN YOUR WAY
• Adaptive lessons that adjust to your mastery and level, from Remember to Create.
• A built-in lesson plan per topic, so you always know the next step.
• On-device tutoring: download a small model once and learn fully offline.

QUIZ THAT ADAPTS
• 5-question sessions that grade your short answers and zero in on gaps.
• Bloom’s-taxonomy progression: build understanding from foundations up.
• Mastery tracking, streaks, XP, levels, and achievements to keep you going.

SEARCH & INGEST
• Search every note and saved source instantly.
• Add material by URL; the app stores and retrieves it on your device.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no servers.
• Everything — profiles, answers, progress, and your imported notes — stays in the app's local database and secure storage.
• Optional Cloud mode is bring-your-own-key (OpenRouter) and requires your consent.
• Lessons and quizzes are generated by an AI model; content is a study aid, not professional advice (see in-app Privacy & AI disclosure).

SELECTED FOR
Anyone 13+ who wants a focused, judgmental-free study partner for Philosophy, Psychology, AI, Physics, Coding, Biology, Chemistry, and more.
en-US.releaseNotes: First release: private local-first AI tutor — on-device model, adaptive quizzes, URL notes, progress tracking, and in-app search.
en-US.promoText: Learn any subject with a private on-device AI tutor, adaptive quizzes, progress tracking, and your own imported notes. No account required.

review.notes: Local-first education app with no account or login. Launch → create a profile → in setup choose "Skip for now — browse in Preview mode". The Learn tab runs lessons and quizzes in Preview mode immediately; Search indexes content added via "Add material (URL)". Contact the reviewer email above for any questions.
